1 #===============================================================================
    2 # User steals the target's item, if the user has none itself. (Covet, Thief)
    3 # Items stolen from wild Pokémon are kept after the battle.
    4 #===============================================================================
    5 class Battle::Move::UserTakesTargetItem < Battle::Move
    6   def pbEffectAfterAllHits(user, target)
    7     return if user.wild?   # Wild Pokémon can't thieve
    8     return if user.fainted?
    9     return if target.damageState.unaffected || target.damageState.substitute
   10     return if !target.item || user.item
   11     return if target.unlosableItem?(target.item)
   12     return if user.unlosableItem?(target.item)
   13     return if target.hasActiveAbility?(:STICKYHOLD) && !@battle.moldBreaker
   14     itemName = target.itemName
   15     user.item = target.item
   16     # Permanently steal the item from wild Pokémon
   17     if target.wild? && !user.initialItem && target.item == target.initialItem
   18       user.setInitialItem(target.item)
   19       target.pbRemoveItem
   20     else
   21       target.pbRemoveItem(false)
   22     end
   23     @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} stole {2}'s {3}!", user.pbThis, target.pbThis(true), itemName))
   24     user.pbHeldItemTriggerCheck
   25   end
   26 end

   28 #===============================================================================
   29 # User gives its item to the target. The item remains given after wild battles.
   30 # (Bestow)
   31 #===============================================================================
   32 class Battle::Move::TargetTakesUserItem < Battle::Move
   33   def ignoresSubstitute?(user)
   34     return true if Settings::MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 6
   35     return super
   36   end
   37 
   38   def pbMoveFailed?(user, targets)

   40       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("But it failed!"))
   41       return true
   42     end
   43     return false
   44   end
   45 
   46   def pbFailsAgainstTarget?(user, target, show_message)
   47     if target.item || target.unlosableItem?(user.item)
   48       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("But it failed!")) if show_message
   49       return true
   50     end
   51     return false
   52   end
   53 
   54   def pbEffectAgainstTarget(user, target)
   55     itemName = user.itemName
   56     target.item = user.item
   57     # Permanently steal the item from wild Pokémon
   58     if user.wild? && !target.initialItem && user.item == user.initialItem
   59       target.setInitialItem(user.item)
   60       user.pbRemoveItem
   61     else
   62       user.pbRemoveItem(false)
   63     end
   64     @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} received {2} from {3}!", target.pbThis, itemName, user.pbThis(true)))
   65     target.pbHeldItemTriggerCheck
   66   end

   69 #===============================================================================
   70 # User and target swap items. They remain swapped after wild battles.
   71 # (Switcheroo, Trick)
   72 #===============================================================================
   73 class Battle::Move::UserTargetSwapItems < Battle::Move
   74   def pbMoveFailed?(user, targets)
   75     if user.wild?
   76       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("But it failed!"))
   77       return true
   78     end
   79     return false
   80   end
   81 
   82   def pbFailsAgainstTarget?(user, target, show_message)
   83     if !user.item && !target.item
   84       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("But it failed!")) if show_message
   85       return true
   86     end
   87     if target.unlosableItem?(target.item) ||
   88        target.unlosableItem?(user.item) ||
   89        user.unlosableItem?(user.item) ||
   90        user.unlosableItem?(target.item)
   91       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("But it failed!")) if show_message
   92       return true
   93     end
   94     if target.hasActiveAbility?(:STICKYHOLD) && !@battle.moldBreaker
   95       if show_message
   96         @battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(target)
   97         if Battle::Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH
   98           @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("But it failed to affect {1}!", target.pbThis(true)))
   99         else
  100           @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("But it failed to affect {1} because of its {2}!",
  101                                   target.pbThis(true), target.abilityName))
  102         end
  103         @battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(target)
  104       end
  105       return true
  106     end
  107     return false
  108   end
  109 
  110   def pbEffectAgainstTarget(user, target)
  111     oldUserItem = user.item
  112     oldUserItemName = user.itemName
  113     oldTargetItem = target.item
  114     oldTargetItemName = target.itemName
  115     user.item                             = oldTargetItem
  116     user.effects[PBEffects::ChoiceBand]   = nil if !user.hasActiveAbility?(:GORILLATACTICS)
  117     user.effects[PBEffects::Unburden]     = (!user.item && oldUserItem) if user.hasActiveAbility?(:UNBURDEN)
  118     target.item                           = oldUserItem
  119     target.effects[PBEffects::ChoiceBand] = nil if !target.hasActiveAbility?(:GORILLATACTICS)
  120     target.effects[PBEffects::Unburden]   = (!target.item && oldTargetItem) if target.hasActiveAbility?(:UNBURDEN)
  121     # Permanently steal the item from wild Pokémon
  122     if target.wild? && !user.initialItem && oldTargetItem == target.initialItem
  123       user.setInitialItem(oldTargetItem)
  124     end
  125     @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} switched items with its opponent!", user.pbThis))
  126     @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} obtained {2}.", user.pbThis, oldTargetItemName)) if oldTargetItem
  127     @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} obtained {2}.", target.pbThis, oldUserItemName)) if oldUserItem
  128     user.pbHeldItemTriggerCheck
  129     target.pbHeldItemTriggerCheck
  130   end
  131 end

  133 #===============================================================================
  134 # User recovers the last item it held and consumed. (Recycle)
  135 #===============================================================================
  136 class Battle::Move::RestoreUserConsumedItem < Battle::Move
  137   def canSnatch?; return true; end
  138 
  139   def pbMoveFailed?(user, targets)
  140     if !user.recycleItem || user.item
  141       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("But it failed!"))
  142       return true
  143     end
  144     return false
  145   end
  146 
  147   def pbEffectGeneral(user)
  148     item = user.recycleItem
  149     user.item = item
  150     user.setInitialItem(item) if @battle.wildBattle? && !user.initialItem
  151     user.setRecycleItem(nil)
  152     user.effects[PBEffects::PickupItem] = nil
  153     user.effects[PBEffects::PickupUse]  = 0
  154     itemName = GameData::Item.get(item).name
  155     if itemName.starts_with_vowel?
  156       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} found an {2}!", user.pbThis, itemName))
  157     else
  158       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} found a {2}!", user.pbThis, itemName))
  159     end
  160     user.pbHeldItemTriggerCheck
  161   end
  162 end

  164 #===============================================================================
  165 # Target drops its item. It regains the item at the end of the battle. (Knock Off)
  166 # If target has a losable item, damage is multiplied by 1.5.
  167 #===============================================================================
  168 class Battle::Move::RemoveTargetItem < Battle::Move
  169   def pbBaseDamage(baseDmg, user, target)
  170     if Settings::MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 6 &&
  171        target.item && !target.unlosableItem?(target.item)
  172       # NOTE: Damage is still boosted even if target has Sticky Hold or a
  173       #       substitute.
  174       baseDmg = (baseDmg * 1.5).round
  175     end
  176     return baseDmg
  177   end
  178 
  179   def pbEffectAfterAllHits(user, target)
  180     return if user.wild?   # Wild Pokémon can't knock off
  181     return if user.fainted?
  182     return if target.damageState.unaffected || target.damageState.substitute
  183     return if !target.item || target.unlosableItem?(target.item)
  184     return if target.hasActiveAbility?(:STICKYHOLD) && !@battle.moldBreaker
  185     itemName = target.itemName
  186     target.pbRemoveItem(false)
  187     @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} dropped its {2}!", target.pbThis, itemName))
  188   end
  189 end

  191 #===============================================================================
  192 # Target's berry/Gem is destroyed. (Incinerate)
  193 #===============================================================================
  194 class Battle::Move::DestroyTargetBerryOrGem < Battle::Move
  195   def pbEffectWhenDealingDamage(user, target)
  196     return if target.damageState.substitute || target.damageState.berryWeakened
  197     return if !target.item || (!target.item.is_berry? &&
  198               !(Settings::MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 6 && target.item.is_gem?))
  199     return if target.unlosableItem?(target.item)
  200     return if target.hasActiveAbility?(:STICKYHOLD) && !@battle.moldBreaker
  201     item_name = target.itemName
  202     target.pbRemoveItem
  203     @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s {2} was incinerated!", target.pbThis, item_name))
  204   end
  205 end

  207 #===============================================================================
  208 # Negates the effect and usability of the target's held item for the rest of the
  209 # battle (even if it is switched out). Fails if the target doesn't have a held
  210 # item, the item is unlosable, the target has Sticky Hold, or the target is
  211 # behind a substitute. (Corrosive Gas)
  212 #===============================================================================
  213 class Battle::Move::CorrodeTargetItem < Battle::Move
  214   def canMagicCoat?; return true; end
  215 
  216   def pbFailsAgainstTarget?(user, target, show_message)
  217     if !target.item || target.unlosableItem?(target.item) ||
  218        target.effects[PBEffects::Substitute] > 0
  219       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} is unaffected!", target.pbThis)) if show_message
  220       return true
  221     end
  222     if target.hasActiveAbility?(:STICKYHOLD) && !@battle.moldBreaker
  223       if show_message
  224         @battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(target)
  225         if Battle::Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH
  226           @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} is unaffected!", target.pbThis))
  227         else
  228           @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} is unaffected because of its {2}!",
  229                                   target.pbThis(true), target.abilityName))
  230         end
  231         @battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(target)
  232       end
  233       return true
  234     end
  235     if @battle.corrosiveGas[target.index % 2][target.pokemonIndex]
  236       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} is unaffected!", target.pbThis)) if show_message
  237       return true
  238     end
  239     return false
  240   end
  241 
  242   def pbEffectAgainstTarget(user, target)
  243     @battle.corrosiveGas[target.index % 2][target.pokemonIndex] = true
  244     @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} corroded {2}'s {3}!",
  245                             user.pbThis, target.pbThis(true), target.itemName))
  246   end
  247 end

  291 #===============================================================================
  292 # The user consumes its held berry increases its Defense by 2 stages. It also
  293 # gains the berry's effect if it has one. The berry can be consumed even if
  294 # Unnerve/Magic Room apply. Fails if the user is not holding a berry. This move
  295 # cannot be chosen to be used if the user is not holding a berry. (Stuff Cheeks)
  296 #===============================================================================
  297 class Battle::Move::UserConsumeBerryRaiseDefense2 < Battle::Move::StatUpMove
  298   def initialize(battle, move)
  299     super
  300     @statUp = [:DEFENSE, 2]
  301   end
  302 
  303   def pbCanChooseMove?(user, commandPhase, showMessages)
  304     item = user.item
  305     if !item || !item.is_berry? || !user.itemActive?
  306       if showMessages
  307         msg = _INTL("{1} can't use that move because it doesn't have a Berry!", user.pbThis)
  308         (commandPhase) ? @battle.pbDisplayPaused(msg) : @battle.pbDisplay(msg)
  309       end
  310       return false
  311     end
  312     return true
  313   end
  314 
  315   def pbMoveFailed?(user, targets)
  316     # NOTE: Unnerve does not stop a Pokémon using this move.
  317     item = user.item
  318     if !item || !item.is_berry? || !user.itemActive?
  319       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("But it failed!"))
  320       return true
  321     end
  322     return super
  323   end
  324 
  325   def pbEffectGeneral(user)
  326     super
  327     @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} ate its {2}!", user.pbThis, user.itemName))
  328     item = user.item
  329     user.pbConsumeItem(true, false)   # Don't trigger Symbiosis yet
  330     user.pbHeldItemTriggerCheck(item.id, false)
  331   end
  332 end

  334 #===============================================================================
  335 # All Pokémon (except semi-invulnerable ones) consume their held berries and
  336 # gain their effects. Berries can be consumed even if Unnerve/Magic Room apply.
  337 # Fails if no Pokémon have a held berry. If this move would trigger an ability
  338 # that negates the move, e.g. Lightning Rod, the bearer of that ability will
  339 # have their ability triggered regardless of whether they are holding a berry,
  340 # and they will not consume their berry. (Teatime)
  341 # TODO: This isn't quite right for the messages shown when a berry is consumed.
  342 #===============================================================================
  343 class Battle::Move::AllBattlersConsumeBerry < Battle::Move
  344   def pbMoveFailed?(user, targets)
  345     failed = true
  346     targets.each do |b|
  347       next if !b.item || !b.item.is_berry?
  348       next if b.semiInvulnerable?
  349       failed = false
  350       break
  351     end
  352     if failed
  353       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("But nothing happened!"))
  354       return true
  355     end
  356     return false
  357   end
  358 
  359   def pbOnStartUse(user, targets)
  360     @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("It's teatime! Everyone dug in to their Berries!"))
  361   end
  362 
  363   def pbFailsAgainstTarget?(user, target, show_message)
  364     return true if !target.item || !target.item.is_berry? || target.semiInvulnerable?
  365     return false
  366   end
  367 
  368   def pbEffectAgainstTarget(user, target)
  369     @battle.pbCommonAnimation("EatBerry", target)
  370     item = target.item
  371     target.pbConsumeItem(true, false)   # Don't trigger Symbiosis yet
  372     target.pbHeldItemTriggerCheck(item.id, false)
  373   end
  374 end

  376 #===============================================================================
  377 # User consumes target's berry and gains its effect. (Bug Bite, Pluck)
  378 #===============================================================================
  379 class Battle::Move::UserConsumeTargetBerry < Battle::Move
  380   def preventsBattlerConsumingHealingBerry?(battler, targets)
  381     return targets.any? { |b| b.index == battler.index } &&
  382            battler.item&.is_berry? && Battle::ItemEffects::HPHeal[battler.item]
  383   end
  384 
  385   def pbEffectAfterAllHits(user, target)
  386     return if user.fainted? || target.fainted?
  387     return if target.damageState.unaffected || target.damageState.substitute
  388     return if !target.item || !target.item.is_berry? || target.unlosableItem?(target.item)
  389     return if target.hasActiveAbility?(:STICKYHOLD) && !@battle.moldBreaker
  390     item = target.item
  391     itemName = target.itemName
  392     user.setBelched
  393     target.pbRemoveItem
  394     @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} stole and ate its target's {2}!", user.pbThis, itemName))
  395     user.pbHeldItemTriggerCheck(item.id, false)
  396     user.pbSymbiosis
  397   end
  398 end

  400 #===============================================================================
  401 # User flings its item at the target. Power/effect depend on the item. (Fling)
  402 #===============================================================================
  403 class Battle::Move::ThrowUserItemAtTarget < Battle::Move
  404   def pbCheckFlingSuccess(user)
  405     @willFail = false
  406     @willFail = true if !user.item || !user.itemActive? || user.unlosableItem?(user.item)
  407     return if @willFail
  408     @willFail = true if user.item.is_berry? && !user.canConsumeBerry?
  409     return if @willFail
  410     @willFail = user.item.flags.none? { |f| f[/^Fling_/i] }
  411   end
  412 
  413   def pbMoveFailed?(user, targets)
  414     if @willFail
  415       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("But it failed!"))
  416       return true
  417     end
  418     return false
  419   end
  420 
  421   def pbDisplayUseMessage(user)
  422     super
  423     pbCheckFlingSuccess(user)
  424     if !@willFail
  425       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} flung its {2}!", user.pbThis, user.itemName))
  426     end
  427   end
  428 
  429   def pbNumHits(user, targets); return 1; end
  430 
  431   def pbBaseDamage(baseDmg, user, target)
  432     return 0 if !user.item
  433     user.item.flags.each do |flag|
  434       return [$~[1].to_i, 10].max if flag[/^Fling_(\d+)$/i]
  435     end
  436     return 10
  437   end
  438 
  439   def pbEffectAgainstTarget(user, target)
  440     return if target.damageState.substitute
  441     return if target.hasActiveAbility?(:SHIELDDUST) && !@battle.moldBreaker
  442     case user.item_id
  443     when :POISONBARB
  444       target.pbPoison(user) if target.pbCanPoison?(user, false, self)
  445     when :TOXICORB
  446       target.pbPoison(user, nil, true) if target.pbCanPoison?(user, false, self)
  447     when :FLAMEORB
  448       target.pbBurn(user) if target.pbCanBurn?(user, false, self)
  449     when :LIGHTBALL
  450       target.pbParalyze(user) if target.pbCanParalyze?(user, false, self)
  451     when :KINGSROCK, :RAZORFANG
  452       target.pbFlinch(user)
  453     else
  454       target.pbHeldItemTriggerCheck(user.item_id, true)
  455     end
  456     # NOTE: The official games only let the target use Belch if the berry flung
  457     #       at it has some kind of effect (i.e. it isn't an effectless berry). I
  458     #       think this isn't in the spirit of "consuming a berry", so I've said
  459     #       that Belch is usable after having any kind of berry flung at you.
  460     target.setBelched if user.item.is_berry?
  461   end
  462 
  463   def pbEndOfMoveUsageEffect(user, targets, numHits, switchedBattlers)
  464     # NOTE: The item is consumed even if this move was Protected against or it
  465     #       missed. The item is not consumed if the target was switched out by
  466     #       an effect like a target's Red Card.
  467     # NOTE: There is no item consumption animation.
  468     user.pbConsumeItem(true, true, false) if user.item
  469   end
  470 end
